fail.summary: Make every plain HTTP request redirect to the HTTPS version of the site.

generic: Find the 'force HTTPS' or 'redirect HTTP to HTTPS' option at your web host or CDN and turn it on.
Make sure the redirect goes to https:// and not to another http:// address.
cpanel: In cPanel open Domains, find your domain and turn on Force HTTPS Redirect.
If that option is missing, install a certificate first (AutoSSL under SSL/TLS Status).

warn.summary: Add or lengthen the HSTS header so browsers always use HTTPS.

generic: Add the response header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
Only add includeSubDomains if every subdomain works over HTTPS.
Start with a short max-age if you are unsure, then raise it to at least 180 days (15552000).
